values: 一名擅长使用阵法的辅助，能够削弱阵法中的敌人并增强友军。
A support who summons a circle that weakens enemies and empowers allies within it.
以女王之名，终结你的亵渎！
女王……我的心仍向您低首……
My queen, my heart kneels only to you.
All who strayed have been purified.
State your purpose. What do you seek?
我会为萨洛克兰扫除所有阴影。
I shall cleanse Sal'thorin of all shadows.
忍耐吧……这是赐予迷途者的恩典。
You must endure, for this is the grace bestowed upon the lost.
I hear your prayers... even in silence, they linger.
此处真是软弱而又堕落啊……
One must not lose one's divine grace...
奎茵是萨洛克兰声望最高的祭司，据说她能让心灵负罪之人在尚未实施罪行前，就主动寻求告解。
Velara is the highest priestess of Sal'thorin. It's said that even those burdened by the heaviest guilt seek her out for confession—sometimes before their sins are even committed.
奎茵出生尊贵，她生于萨洛克兰最大的祭司家族，是当初大贤者的旁系后代。
She was born into the largest priestly family in Sal'thorin and is a collateral descendant of the Great Sage.
奎茵一手主导了萨洛克兰王城的城建工作。此后，她的声望一日胜过一日。
Velara personally oversaw the construction of the royal city, shaping it according to the Queen's vision. With every stone laid, her influence grew stronger.
“一次议事中，有人提到贤者的直系后代更适合领导众祭司，奎茵冕下只是微笑了一下。后来再也没人见过那位大人。” ——祭司间的内部流言。

"During one meeting, someone suggested that only a direct descendant of Sage Tasso should lead the priests. High Priestess Velara merely smiled. That man disappeared soon after." —A whisper among the priesthood
奎茵与斐利尔的关系在人们口中莫衷一是。奎茵一手将斐利尔提拔为最年轻的高阶祭司，却只给他安排一些琐碎的工作。
Public opinion about Velara's relationship with Feli is divided. Though she promoted him to be the youngest high priest in history, she assigned him only trivial duties.
三长老之间常有不睦传闻，相比于另外两人，女王与奎茵更为亲近。
Rumors of discord among the Three Exarchs are common—but of the trio, it's said the Queen shares the closest bond with Velara.
“奎茵冕下从不吃宴会上提供的食物，据说她的饮食只有恩典灵露一种。” ——宴会厅的仆从们暗地里交换这样的八卦。
"They say High Priestess Velara never touches the food at banquets—she only drinks Divine Dew, and nothing else." —Gossip exchanged among the banquet hall servants
很少有人知道奎茵曾在女王面前表现出过恐惧，她几乎为此付出了生命的代价，但那次事件后，她成为了女王最忠诚的信徒。
Few know that Velara once showed fear before the Queen—a moment that nearly cost her her life. But from that day on, she served with unwavering devotion, becoming the Queen's most loyal follower.
奎茵手中的权杖是大祭司权柄的象征，在她的就任仪式上由女王亲手授予，自那以后，她从未让任何人触碰这根权杖。
Her staff isn't just a symbol of power—it's a sacred gift from the Queen, given during her inauguration. Since then, no one but Velara has dared to touch it.
“在死亡的漆黑中，是女王至柔的恩典拯救了我，让我看清自己的愚昧。从此我的血与灵，都为她所驱使。”
"In death's pitch-black embrace, it was the Queen's gentle grace that delivered me—and showed me the depths of my folly. From that day forward, both my blood and soul have belonged to her will."
沙利叶，我无意重复你那没有原则的风流引发的诸多舆论，也无意纠正你手下卫队的不洁与混乱。
Ravion, I'm not here to lecture you about your questionable private life, nor do I care to deal with your unruly guards.
哦？你问为何会有贵族和平民的分别？
The difference between the nobles and commoners, you ask?
Hey, pinkskin. Move out of the way.
此处真是软弱而又堕落啊……
